protocol.acceptance: Report each criterion independently; do not reinterpret a false physical/robustness criterion as an implementation failure. Every completed trajectory must invert exactly.
allowed_changes: one of eight preselected tensor sign triples
protocol.continuation: Only a source-created coupled localized motif with an inert source-absent control can advance to attachment/breakup search. Otherwise retain preloaded and signal-responsive results separately.

observations.attachment_breakup: Not certified by period change alone; would require identifiable initially separated compact motifs to join and later separate through autonomous motion. This study supplies no such acceptance shortcut.
observations.full_state_first_return: First exact state equality to initial state at t=1,...,12; full trace through t=40 retained as hashes.
observations.inactive_control: Target counters remain zero for every sampled source-absent time.
observations.interaction: At least one target local triple differs from a separately evolved isolated clock with the same initial local triple.
observations.localized_motif: Every nonbackground channel stays at the two initially prepared target spatial sites for all t=0,...,40.
observations.memory: M=1 exactly when the local (r0,r14)=(0,4); click is its 0-to-1 transition.
observations.operational_bound_motif: A two-site motif with full-state first return <=12, localization and interaction. This is a coupled recurrent pattern, not demonstrated spatial attachment or physical binding.
observations.postarrival_period5: For signal runs, the four target channel triples at sites x=59,60 are compared at t and t+5 for t=16,...,30 (six state values per site, twelve total).
observations.source_response: First exact difference at either target between source-present and otherwise identical source-absent runs.

protocol.question: Do adjacent prepared clocks form a localized interacting recurrence, and does an incoming prepared signal create or disrupt it?
protocol.registration: Written before this script's first run; within-session registration only.
protocol.tensor_family: All eight triples in {-1,+1}^3 for adjacent pairs; positive signs for separation and signal studies.
